d: Ksar Sghir Beach (Ksar El Majaz beach): the area’s main beach, calm sea and weak currents, lifeguards and free parasols in summer, a kids’ play area, and how to get there from Tangier and Fnideq.
Dalia Beach: Blue Flag 11 times, clean sand, summer activities and a beach library, an area for visitors with special needs, a sailing school, plus safety tips and how to get there.

t: Belyounech: the beach, the village and Jebel Musa
d: Belyounech, at the foot of Jebel Musa: a sandy beach with lifeguards in summer, diving schools, rod fishing, the Jebel Musa hike with a local, and how to get there from Fnideq and Ksar Sghir.
Tanger Med port near Ksar Sghir: official 2025 figures (11.1 million containers, 3.2 million passengers), history, ferries to Algeciras and access by bus I3.

Ksar Sghir archaeological site: a circular Marinid town on the Strait of Gibraltar, crossing point to al-Andalus, Portuguese from 1458 to 1550, uncovered by Moroccan-American excavations from 1972 to 1981.
Ksar Sghir traditional fishing port: fishermen’s boats, tuna season, fresh Mediterranean fish sold in central Ksar Sghir, and tips for buying fish.
Zahara / Hatba Beach: a quiet sandy cove 3 km west of Ksar Sghir, the closest to town, lifeguards June to September, seasonal kiosks and restaurants, buses I3 and I12.
Ghojin / Srama Beach: a quiet sandy cove 8 km west of Ksar Sghir, quiet and family-friendly, lifeguards June to September, seasonal kiosks and restaurants, buses I3 and I12.
Ferdiwa Beach: a quiet sandy cove 10 km west of Ksar Sghir, fishing boats and rod fishing, lifeguards June to September, seasonal kiosks and restaurants, buses I3 and I12.
Dahdaha Beach: a quiet sandy cove 15 km west of Ksar Sghir, a family beach framed by hills, lifeguards June to September, seasonal kiosks, buses I3 and I12.
Diki port: a small traditional fishing port west of Ksar Sghir, between Zahara / Hatba and Ghojin / Srama, where fresh fish is sold right by the port, with a tuna season.
Oued Alian Beach: a large sandy beach with weak currents 15 km from Ksar Sghir, lifeguards June to September, seasonal kiosks and restaurants, showers and toilets, buses I3 and I12.
Zrara Beach 1 & 2: a quiet sandy cove 20 km west of Ksar Sghir, two family coves framed by hills, lifeguards June to September, seasonal kiosks, buses I3 and I12.
Oued Marsa Beach: a family beach through and through, 12 km from Ksar Sghir, weak currents, lifeguards June to September, restaurants, cafés and seasonal kiosks, fishing boats on the shore.
Sidi Kankouch 2 Beach: a quiet sandy cove 23 km west of Ksar Sghir, parasols and toilets, lifeguards June to September, seasonal kiosks and restaurants, buses I3 and I12.
Sidi Kankouch 1 Beach: wide sand and weak currents 10 km from Tangier, free parasols, showers and an activity platform in summer, lifeguards June to September, buses I3 and I12.
